nodes.parked_reason: certification ceiling: 8 failing round(s), ceiling 8; failing tier(s) unit, product; stuck on product; first break tools/launchd/app.okolos.feed.plist ProgramArguments line `if [ "$c" -ne 0 ] && [ "$c" -ne 75 ] && ! grep ...`; tools/feed/bootstrap.mjs:513; tools/is-main.mjs:32-38: A launch whose node is older than 20.11 (no import.meta.filename) fails silently, exit 0 and no record. isMain(undefined) returns false (realpath throws, caught), so the bootstrap's main never runs and node exits 0; the launch line treats exit 0 as success without checking for a record of its id. The plist prefers the login shell's `node` (from a version manager, as its own comment says) over the installer's node, and nothing checks that node's version against engines (^22.18.0 || >=23.6.0). Every run would then end in 0 with no record, the B-149 shape this node exists to close. On the launchd path every genuine exit 0 already leaves a record carrying the id (published or skipped from the job's finish, adopted records stamped), so 'exit 0 without a record of this id' is unambiguous.; check: A test in tools/install-feed-agent.test.ts that runs the rendered launch line with a fake node on PATH that exits 0 without writing the status file, and expects feed-status.json with stage launch, runId of that launch and consecutiveFailures incremented; plus a bootstrap test calling the main guard with import.meta.filename undefined that expects a non-zero exit.. Blocker row owed on the board
